description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0015 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Transaction status for polling: up to 10 tx hashes in one call, searched across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon (or one chain): pending / success / failed / not_found, block, confirmations, finalized flag, from/to, gas used, fee in native coin, explorer link. When to use: Use tx-status to poll whether transactions are pending, confirmed, failed or finalized (up to 10 hashes, chain auto-detected). Use tx-explain for a full decode of one tx.

hash.description: tx hash (0x + 64 hex), or comma list of up to 10
